name: @mhbzhy-lost/pi-dcp
description: Minimal Pi 1.6.1-native tail-local context pruning and monotone folding extension built on context_edit.

scripts.check:loc: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const files=["index.ts",...fs.readdirSync("src").filter(f=>f.endsWith(".ts")).sort().map(f=>p.join("src",f))];let total=0,bad=[];for(const f of files){const n=fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8").split("\n").filter(l=>l.trim().length>0).length;total+=n;console.log(`${String(n).padStart(4)}  ${f}`);if(n>180)bad.push(`${f}=${n}>180`);}console.log(`Total: ${total}/650`);if(total>650)bad.push(`total=${total}>650`);if(bad.length){console.error("LOC budget exceeded:",bad.join(", "));process.exit(1);}'
